method: Manual assistant review of every reported claim and qualification against the cited inspected source versions and frozen case oracles. Exact duplicate outputs reused already reviewed labels only after matching claim text, qualification and versioned excerpts. Semantic labels are provisional until independently human-calibrated. Unsupported and supported occurrences are kept separate when their citations differ in adequacy.
gradingValidation: After all 54 scans finished, review validation was tightened to require each credited relationship to cite its required sources in one finding. This did not change any baseline grade. Runtime, prompts, fixtures and model configuration were unchanged throughout the live benchmark; every starting code fingerprint matched at completion.
